items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2MjA5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--463619da1a2757f26586f367329c079b40ee3e58/2.png) This competition is supported by the *[Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)* as the Heartland Regional Championship of 2027. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE5MjMzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--040dd9e49441c4c13c4c62a3d53752aa4ea97033/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png) Competitors from Iowa, Kansas, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota and South Dakota are eligible for the title of Heartland Champion.
